2002.author: Jianyu010
2002.body:
Fixes #2001

### Why

At the first Bridge start, `LiveIngestionJob` records the owner's cutoff, and live ingestion covers only positions above it. Under §7b, positions at or below the cutoff belong to `BackfillRunner(handoff=...)`, but nothing in production called it. An upgraded v0.1.12 workspace therefore never got its old Home tasks, approved memories or Beebou turns into Global Memory.

### What

- `LiveIngestionJob.start()` authorizes the cutoff as before. It then builds one `BackfillRunner.in_directory(<provider dir>, source, provider, handoff=ledger.for_source(id))` per authorized source.
- `LiveIngestionJob.backfill()` drains each unfinished runner before every live pass. A source whose pass fails, or whose provider answer is unknown, is retried on the next tick without holding the other sources. Progress is durable per source (`hive-history-backfill.<source_id>.sqlite3`), so it runs once per workspace and a finished source is skipped.
- `live.toml [live] backfill = true` is the switch. The settings parser validates it.
- No model judge is wired. As in live ingestion, old turns are classified by rules and citations only, and ambiguous ones are kept as unclassified fragments.
- Docs: `temp/hive-memory/README.md` and §7b of `beebou-hive-phase3-delivery.md`.

### Tests

New `JobBackfillTests` in `test_hive_memory_live.py`, on the real legacy store, Hive Store and provider:
- the first start backfills old tasks, memory and the Beebou turn as historical, while a later task goes through live;
- a restart in a new process adds no unit, ingest call or publication;
- `backfill = false` leaves the old library out.

Local runs on Python 3.13:
- `temp/hive-memory/tests`: 74 passed
- `test_hive_live_ingestion_startup.py` and `test_hive_memory_home_feed_boundary.py`: 9 passed
- `tests/architecture` import, domain and transition checks: 71 passed

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

2006.body:
## Summary The architecture CI gate checks static imports and registrations only. It cannot tell whether policy sits in the right owner, whether an adapter stays thin, whether a second writer appears at runtime, or whether code matches its reviewed design. This PR collects the Issue-to-merge rules, which are currently spread across `AGENTS.md`, `temp/AGENTS.md`, the protocols and the migration developer guide, into one protocol page with traceable IDs, plus a skill that coding agents follow. - **`docs/protocols/development.md`**: stable `DEV-01..15` rules, each linked to its authoritative source. Lanes **B** (bug fix), **F** (feature within accepted boundaries) and **A** (architecture-changing feature) have their own design obligations (`DEV-F1..F6`, `DEV-A1..A6`). The page also covers the `temp//` placement table and design upload and versioning under `docs/assets/feature-design/`. It defines the `

-D/S/C/T` traceability IDs, a **PR trace block**, and a ten-question self-review for what CI misses. - **`.agents/skills/digitalmate-development/`**: the ordered procedure (`SKILL.md`), `references/design-upload.md`, and `scripts/check_trace.py`, a stdlib checker for the PR trace block. The checker verifies that the design, spec, ADR, `ownership.json` and test files exist, that the design is indexed, that lane A IDs are defined in the spec, and that every check has a status. It is a contributor tool, not a CI gate. - **`docs/protocols/README.md`** gets an emphasized entry block and a new task row. `feature-development.md` and the existing `digitalmate-dev` skill cross-link to the new page. `UPDATES.md` has a dated entry. Root `AGENTS.md` is unchanged. It already routes readers to the protocols index, and changes to it need separate maintainer authorization. ## Verification - `python3.13 -B -m unittest test_check_trace` (in the skill's `scripts/`) → PASS, 12 tests - `python3.13 -B tools/architecture/check.py --policy docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json --root . --format json` → PASS (exit 0, 0 findings) - `python3.13 -B tools/architecture/transition.py --check ...` → PASS (exit 0) - Relative links and anchors in all changed Markdown files → PASS. The only two unresolved targets are placeholder text inside an inline code example. - Device ST: NOT_RUN (documentation and contributor tooling only; no runtime input changed) 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

2007.author: Jianyu010
2007.body:
Fixes #1726

## 设计与 owner

设计稿：`docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-status-consumption-1726.md`，已链接到 Issue #1726 的 Design Ideas。

- Session Store 仍是唯一持久 writer；Host 保留模型、工具和上下文权限；Harness 只持有 RAM 执行状态。
- 所有 `report(status)`（包括 Bee 提问知会）各自进入 report-only 轮，不新增 ask wire kind；用户答案仍直接恢复原 Bee 等待点。
- 无 pending user 时 status/done 分别按 seq 有界分页；status 的 retry/backoff 不再遮蔽有效 done。
- 保留每任务 4 条 pending / 8 条累计 status 配额、同 ID 幂等、done 终态校验、用户优先、Stop 和问答独立通道。

**设计评审尚未完成**：合入前需 Session Store（#1311）、Beebou Harness / Host（#1310 / #1309）、Delivery（#1223）及 SC02-B1 场景负责人签收。

## 实现

- Store 认领 status 并写入可信 `bee_status` EVENT；只有对应 COMPLETED Run 才能作为 status 消费见证，旧通用 ACK 端口不能凭任意字符串清 status。
- Host 增加显式 `complete_without_output` / `completed_report_snapshot` 窄接口；普通用户和 done 的非空答复校验不变。
- Harness 允许 status 无用户输出，Store 原子提交 context revision、`COMPLETED, answer=NULL` 和 `consume_witness=run_id`，不写伪造助手答复。
- NULL 完成仅限 status；user NULL 完成和藏在 NULL 提交中的未声明助手答复均被拒绝。
- Harness drain 处理独立 status，deferred status 不阻塞后续有效 done；失败恢复、重放与并发沿用原 Run/UNKNOWN 对账。
- SC02-B1 更新为“提问 status 独立静默成轮 + 原 Bee 直接恢复”，不是删除通知或削弱权限断言。

## 本地验证

基线：`34a156f201627497f6fe92974c071cf25586899c`。实现提交见本 PR head。真实参与者为 SQLite Session Store、HostAPI、NativeBeebouRunner、BeebouHarness、CLI Bridge 和受控 HTTP 模型；受控 Bee runtime / Host isolation witness 在测试中明确标注。

已通过：

- `test_hive_bee_induced_reply.py`：**17 passed, 5 xfailed**。新增独立静默轮、真实消费见证、多页 done 推进、deferred status、崩溃恢复、并发、权限及 NULL 负例。5 个 xfail 为原有 a/b/d/R1/R2 非本项缺口，未改成 PASS。
- 直接相关组合（报告链路、Host、Harness、Store 配额、兼容端口）：**97 passed, 5 xfailed, 57 subtests passed**。
- `test_dm31_a06.py` + `test_beebou_harness.py`：**52 passed, 57 subtests passed**。
- Beebou 场景机制相关五个文件：**39 passed, 1 skipped**（既有环境/条件跳过）。
- 问答与 SC03 owner 测试：**16 passed, 6 skipped**（既有条件跳过）。
- 架构检查器：**244 passed**。
- `manifest.py --check`、`transition.py --check` 通过；`check.py --format json` 扫描 **577 files / 335 checked files，findings=[]**。
- 修改文件 `py_compile`、场景 TOML 解析和 `git diff --check` 通过。

完整套件结果（不记为全绿）：

- Bridge + `temp/hive-beebou` + `temp/hive-runtime`：**6440 passed, 29 failed, 114 skipped, 5 xfailed, 15 errors, 26330 subtests passed**。其中 `test_consumed_terminal_context.py` 暴露一个本项反例：伪造 status metadata 被过滤。后续 commit `77250d8d7` 已要求 status 内容与 metadata 一致、保留旧 done payload，针对性复验 **22 passed, 5 xfailed**。其余失败/错误集中于本地子进程解释器与导入环境、Unix socket 路径、未注册 async 插件及安装包/隔离前提，不能用本次源码测试替代可信 CI。
- `tests/scenarios/hive`：**223 passed, 87 failed, 126 skipped**。失败主要为同类本地运行时/Unix socket 环境问题和基线 launcher 行为；直接相关的 39 项场景机制与 16 项问答 owner 测试通过范围如上，不把全套记为通过。

Rebase 后验证（base `34a156f201627497f6fe92974c071cf25586899c`）：针对性组合 **104 passed, 5 xfailed, 57 subtests passed**；`git diff --check` 通过。

## 未运行 / 阻塞

- `scripts/ci/server-tests.py --suite server-contracts` 和 `architecture-shadow`：受保护 runner 拒绝本地候选阶段执行，未运行成功，等待可信 CI。
- 真实模型、完整 SC02-B1 产品场景、设备、部署、GitHub CI / ST：**NOT_RUN**。
- Ruff 全文件检查暴露仓库既有格式/未使用项，未将其作为本次通过门禁；本次以编译、真实测试和架构检查为准。

2008.author: huben0423-hw
2008.body:
## 问题

最新 main 构建服务端镜像直接失败，任何人都无法产出镜像（#2005）：

```
#26 [bot-build 23/27] COPY temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city /build/temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city
#26 ERROR: failed to calculate checksum of ref ...: "/temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city": not found
```

## 根因

真正的构建上下文过滤器是 `harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile.dockerignore`（与 Dockerfile 同名的 `<Dockerfile>.dockerignore`，BuildKit 优先于仓库根的 `.dockerignore`）。它是白名单式规则：先 `**` 全排除，再逐条 `!` 放行。

#1903（`fix(weather): 按本次设备定位查询本地天气`，合并于 2026-11-18 16:01 +08，merge commit `63ce28529`）在 `Dockerfile` 第 62 行新增了

```
COPY temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city /build/temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city
```

但同一 PR **只改了 `Dockerfile`，没有同步 `Dockerfile.dockerignore`** 的白名单。被忽略规则排除的路径在 BuildKit 里表现为 `not found`，于是 COPY 校验失败，构建在依赖层之前就终止。

模块本身在仓库里是完整的（`git ls-files temp/device-weather-city` 有 `src/dm_device_weather_city/__init__.py` 等），不是文件缺失。

## 修复

在 `harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile.dockerignore` 中，按现有 `bee-artifacts` 段的同构格式补 8 行：

```
!temp/device-weather-city/
temp/device-weather-city/**
!temp/device-weather-city/src/
temp/device-weather-city/src/**
!temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city/
!temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city/**
temp/device-weather-city/src/**/__pycache__/
temp/device-weather-city/src/**/*.pyc
```

只改这一个文件，不动 Dockerfile、不动任何 Python 源码，也不改变镜像内容构成（只是让已被 COPY 声明的目录真正进入构建上下文）。

## 验证

同一 ADX `adx-jiuwen-test-6` 的独立 BuildKit Pod（buildkit v0.25.2，`linux/amd64`，`--local dockerfile=<ctx>/harness/personal-agent/deploy`）：

- 未打补丁：在同一位置失败（`COPY temp/device-weather-city` → `not found`），两次复现一致
- 打补丁后：COPY 校验通过，构建继续完成 pip 依赖、wheel 构建、层导出与推送

补丁生效的那次构建源码为：main `38c4d124` + 无关 PR #1924（`88b771f2c`）+ 本修复（`6a2d8fdf2`），镜像已推送并验真：

```
swr.ap-southeast-1.myhuaweicloud.com/openjiuwen-online-test/digitalmate:pr1924v2-20261118-1745-6a2d8fd-test-6
digest        sha256:d0c14b2e38c43ecddf571210fa2940abc27be9238fdf7911f5ff78ac4c8b2187
config digest sha256:223cf30a31f52d947ab3f5f156d201c55980a2c4fabf85d905f97c5841a6f0eb
revision      (集成分支提交) · platform linux/amd64 · 12 层
```

远端校验：manifest 字节重算 sha256 == 远端 `Docker-Content-Digest`、config blob 哈希与 metadata 一致、`registry.py verify` 返回 `verified: true`。

未运行：仓库 CI（node-ut / hypium-ut / 架构检查）。本改动只触及构建上下文清单，不涉及运行时代码；纯 main + 本修复的完整镜像构建未单独复跑（上述成功构建包含一个与该路径无关的 PR）。

Closes #2005
Refs #1903
CC @lh913137941（原 PR 作者，麻烦确认白名单格式是否符合你的预期）

2010.author: Jianyu010
2010.body:
Rollout step 4 of [place-resolution-v1](docs/implementations/contracts/place-resolution-v1.md): the #1335 Registry consumer that makes "current location" real for weather.

Refs #1983
Refs #1335

## What changes

**Server (Host)**
- `device_weather_city` stays a zero-argument Bee tool registered through Registry; its descriptor (`device_city_tool`) now declares `place = "city"` and takes its description from config. Its implementation identity includes the configured wording.
- `PlaceGuard.check_device_city`: the reader is admitted only for a task whose stored place is `current_location`. No place gives `PLACE_MISSING`; a `named` or `conversation` task gives `PLACE_NOT_CURRENT_LOCATION` (the place the person named or picked wins, with no device read). The Bee gate now shows a reader's task-bound `EffectRefused` reason instead of a generic refusal. No refusal carries a place name.
- A completed city (and region) is recorded in the task's `TaskPlaces`, so `native_weather` with `{source: current_location, name: <city>}` passes `PlaceGuard`, and no other city does.
- `permission_denied`, `service_disabled`, `location_unavailable`, `revoked`, `timeout`, `cancelled` and `device_unavailable` return `{status, detail}`. `detail` is the configured next step: say why, ask the person to type a city, and do not call again or guess. Nothing is recorded, so there is no fallback place. The owner already asks only the originating socket, at most once per Run.
- `place_tool_listings` leaves zero-argument place-aware tools out, so the Bee keeps the reader's own zero-argument listing.
- Beebou's `device_weather_rule` now says to tell the person why and ask for a typed city, never using the IP address, network country, memory or an earlier city.

**Phone (PLR-C7, ADR-0025)**
- `ensureDeviceCityLocationGrant` reuses any existing grant with no prompt. With no OS grant, it shows the system dialog once, for approximate (city-level) access only. A first grant turns on the app's location switch at approximate precision. A refusal is remembered and not asked again. A saved app opt-out with an OS grant still in place is respected.
- Coordinates stay on the phone (DWC-C4). The server still admits only bounded city/region strings.

**Config, no hard-coded tunables**
- `place_guard.toml`: `device_weather_city_description`, `PLACE_NOT_CURRENT_LOCATION`, and `[place_guard.device_city]` with `timeout_ms` (the owner's wait, which now covers the OS dialog; a test checks it stays below the Bee gate's `decision_timeout_ms`) and the per-status `unavailable` wording. Every key is required.

**Docs**
- Contract PLR-C10 (table plus an "Implementation (step 4)" section) and PLR-R, the DWC status line, and `docs/implementations/UPDATES.md`.

## Tests
- New `test_hive_device_city_reader.py` covers:
  - the descriptor and registration shape;
  - `current_location`-only admission;
  - the result recorded in `TaskPlaces`, and `native_weather` accepting that city and refusing others;
  - each failure status giving the type-a-city detail with no fallback;
  - a source with no authorization never reaching the phone;
  - coordinate/address sentinels and place names absent from the model result, `TaskPlaces` and logs.
- `test_hive_device_city_transport.py` (real WebSocket path): no place and named-place refusals before any device request; a repeat call says why.
- `test_place_guard.py`: new config keys fail closed.
- `tests/unit/device-permissions.test.mjs`: grant reuse without a dialog, one approximate dialog with no grant, a remembered refusal, app opt-out, and a stale request.
- `tests/unit/device-city-request.test.mjs`: the grant step runs before the read; `permission_denied` sends no city.
- Local results:
  - Python suites for `hive-runtime`, `hive-beebou`, `device-weather-city` and `agent_bridge`: every failure also fails on unmodified main (8 environment-specific tests).
  - Node unit suite: 3535 passed. The 3 failures are Chromium visual captures unavailable on this machine.
  - The architecture scan is clean.

## Device acceptance
An emulator run against a cloud test environment built from this branch is in progress. Results will be added here before merging.

2011.author: Jianyu010
2011.body:
Closes #2000
Refs #1983

## What
The Bee's `native_weather` now defaults to today but accepts the day or days the user asks about. Contract: [place-resolution-v1 PLR-C11](docs/implementations/contracts/place-resolution-v1.md).

### Bee schema
| Before (step 3) | After |
| --- | --- |
| `{place}` required, `additionalProperties: false` | `{place, date?, days?}`: `place` required; `date` is `YYYY-MM-DD` (first day); `days` is an integer 1..`max_days` and requires `date`; `additionalProperties: false` |

- No `date`: today in the **task's time zone**, which is the PLR-C2 zone of the dispatching message (the client's reported zone, else the workspace default). Beebou's dispatch records it with the place in the Host-owned `TaskZones` (`dm_hive_runtime.assembly.weather_dates`). The Bee never passes a zone.
- `native_weather` runs as a gate bound effect (`BeeProductSearch.apply_bound`). The provider's `start_date`/`end_date` come from the bound Task and are checked again there, never taken raw from model input.
- `place_guard.toml`'s `native_weather_description` no longer says "today".

### Beebou
`date_rule` in `place_resolution.toml` is appended to the place instruction. Beebou turns 明天/后天/周五/这周末/未来N天/tomorrow/Friday/this weekend/next N days into concrete `YYYY-MM-DD` dates against the time line and writes them into the Bee task. The Bee copies them and never computes a relative day. Answers name the place and the date(s) and cite each forecast date.

### Provider
`engine_weather.forecast(..., start_date, end_date)` requests Open-Meteo `daily` with `start_date`/`end_date` and returns `dates` plus one `days[]` row per local day (`weather`, `high_c`, `low_c`, `precipitation_mm`, `precipitation_probability_percent`, `rain_expected`). A request for exactly the place's own today keeps the existing today view (`forecast_days=1`, current hour). Without dates, behaviour is unchanged (automation, Home weather, `engine_tools_mcp`).

### Limits and past days
- `weather_dates.toml` sets `horizon_days = 13` (today through today + 13) and `max_days = 7`, plus all wording.
- Refusals: `DATE_INVALID`, `DATE_RANGE_TOO_LONG`, `DATE_PAST`, `DATE_BEYOND_HORIZON`, `DATE_ZONE_MISSING`.
- **Past days are refused**, not served from the archive API. That keeps one endpoint and one result shape. Beebou tells the user past weather is unavailable.

Out of scope: Home weather (`HomeWeather`, today-only consent) is unchanged.

## Tests
- `temp/hive-runtime/tests/test_weather_dates.py`: the default today in the task zone, including Shanghai ahead of UTC and Los Angeles behind UTC; a single date; a range; beyond the horizon; a past date; invalid input; the config loader; `TaskZones`; the Bee schema; refusals through `BeeProductSearch`; and that a dated tool never runs unbound.
- `test_engine_weather_dates.py`: the provider's query parameters (`daily`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `timezone`, no `forecast_days`), the daily rows, that the place's own today keeps the today view, that a request without dates is unchanged, coordinates, incomplete responses, invalid windows, and the MCP date arguments.
- `test_hive_beebou_place_dispatch.py`: the zone is carried from dispatch to the Bee (only with an accepted place), and `_turn_zone` uses the client zone or the default.
- `test_beebou_place_window.py`: `date_rule` is required and appended to the instruction.
- Existing place/listing/product-search/device-city tests now record a zone with the place.
- Eval data: `tests/eval/hive-live/regression-cases/2000-weather-dates.json` (5 zh/en relative-date cases; validated by `node --test tests/eval/hive-live.test.mjs`, not run live).

2013.author: Jianyu010
2013.body:
Fixes #1759

## 方案

- 新增显式 `RetainedBeeHarness`：由 release 同时保留原 factory、原 identity 与当前 factory；只允许 core 不同，model/tools/skills 和 owned adapter 必须一致。
- `ready_for` 遍历 current/retained 的精确 Profile。旧 factory 临时未就绪保持 queued；只有全部就绪且当前 revision 无匹配才形成 `BindingConflict`。
- 执行、问答和终局见证继续 resolve 原 Store binding；Stop 搜索 current/retained factory 的原 lane。新 Bee 只绑定 current，未传 retained 时 #1496/#1557 行为不变。
- 不改 Store schema、binding 字节或重试语义；不复活驱逐身份、不自动重放未知效果。

## 设计与评审阻塞

包含版本化契约、ADR-0034 和 8 页架构评审稿，覆盖执行、问答、queue/steer、Stop、终局见证、两阶段滚动升级、重启/恢复、重放/丢 ACK。

**PROPOSED：合并前仍需 Runtime/Host、Registry、Store/Manager、Bot owner 完成 D1/C1–C4 设计评审。** #1559 的 roster/派发拒绝不在本 PR 重复实现；#1899 的 successor proof 不在本方案采用。

## 已运行

- 新增 retained binding 定向组合：5/5 通过（真实 SQLite Store、Registry/Host、WorkSwarm adapter，受控 wire/model/witness）。
- Bee verifier、Stop、原 unavailable terminal、answer lane 相关回归：55/55 通过。
- routing readiness：15/15 通过。
- 架构源码测试：244/244 通过；可信 runner/CI 入口未运行。
- 真实安装态 WorkSwarm queue/steer 升级组合：1/1 通过。使用仓库 `install_runtime.py --build-only` 构建并验证 patched wheels；真实 Store/WorkSwarm/Registry/Host，受控模型和 Host isolation witness。v1 原 factory 执行并消费 queue，v2 不接管旧 Session，两个 turn 的 context/completion 均提交。
- `kimi-slides check`、Python 语法和 `git diff --check` 通过。

原始 vendored 源码未带完成证明时，真实 queue 用例按预期以 `WorkSwarm runtime completion is unconfirmed` 失败；改用上述 patched wheels 后通过。未删除或弱化任何断言。

## 未运行 / 范围

- 未运行 HarmonyOS 设备、真实云模型、真实外部 provider、真实多实例容器滚动部署或线上数据验收。
- 未把本地架构测试称为可信 CI，也未声称部署/回滚已完成。
- 本地依赖环境有 FastAPI/google-api-core 与 WorkSwarm OpenTelemetry `<1.42` 的解析冲突；安装态用例实际通过，但完整生产依赖一致性仍需部署门禁确认。

2017.author: LuckySamoyed
2017.body:
## 背景

#1318：Beebou→Bee 的一轮任务跑超 Host 预算时，原来只有一句英文内部常量
「Stopped at the task budget」，这一轮已经搜过什么、读过什么、做到哪全部丢失；
同时 Home 里的止损卡片会漂到对话尾部，脱离它所属的那一轮。

本 PR 只针对产品路径 Beebou→Bee。

## 改动

### 1. 预算止损带出「这一轮干了什么」（蜂群路径）
- `temp/hive-runtime`：新增 `turn_progress.py`，逐帧观测一轮的进行时状态
  （正文只留最后 4000 字；搜索/已读页面/成功调用/未完成调用各最多 10 条），
  纯内存、turn 结束即释放，不落盘。
- `bee_runtime.py`：预算到点由同一个可见证的 `HostBeeStop`
  （`budget:<run_id>:<generation>`）结束该轮，note 由 `budget_text` 用快照生成，
  随 `TextOutcome("stopped", text=note)` 落库到 `dm_hive_stopped_results.text`。
- `hive_bee_runtime.py`：绑定 turn 预算（`DIGITALMATE_BEE_TURN_BUDGET_S` /
  `EXECUTION_CEILING_S`），并把 adapter 的等待超时设为预算 + 60s。
- 停工说明按任务语言输出：做了什么、缺什么、怎么继续（「回我一句『继续』」）；
  locked budget 改为提示「没法直接接着跑，请重做一次」。

### 2. 止损卡片留在自己那一轮下面
- `hive_store.py`：stopped terminal 按 `stopped_at_ms` 投影为持久行，
  以 dispatch seq 为键、经 `dm_hive_result_notices`（version=1）关联；
  terminal 行携带 `terminal_text`、`task_ref`，可被客户端按 task 回收。
- `DigitalMateConversation.ets`：任务进入 `terminalTasks` 后，客户端退休对应的
  实时 stopped 通知，避免尾部再出现重复的一行。

### 3. 引擎侧共用文案
- `engine_activity.budget_stop_note` / `engine_service.stop_output`：
  用任务语言生成说明；`ExecutionResult.progress`（`TurnProgress`，列表上限 20）承载进度。
- 预算止损同时把 note 写入消息流，供 HAP 与 Home 两条显示路径共用。

## 测试

- 新增 `test_budget_stop_note.py`、`test_hive_runtime_turn_budget.py`、
  `test_hive_runtime_turn_progress.py`，并补充 Home terminal / stop store /
  context terminal 及客户端 `HiveBeeTerminalHome` 用例。
- bridge pytest `-k "hive or bee"`：967 passed / 25 skipped / 7 xfailed；
  8 个失败全部与本次改动无关——4 个在纯净 upstream `eee644066` 上同样复现
  （`time_note` ×2 因上游新增能力元数据系统消息、`quote_frames` 因上游新增
  `timing` 字段、`runtime_flow` 20s 回执超时），4 个 session_proximity 用例
  在并发全量下超时、单独复跑通过。
- 客户端 Node UT 31 项全部通过。

## 设备验收

- 镜像 `v202611184-adx-jiuwen-test-2`（commit `e77ebb926`），HAP 安装于
  `7XNYD26516010915`，2026-11-18 验收通过：
  第一次止损说明在「继续」上方；重新提交后第二轮止损说明紧跟它自己那一轮，
  不再出现重复的尾部卡片。
2017.head: fix/issue-1318-budget-stop-language
2017.title: fix(hive): end a Bee turn at its budget with a note of its work, under its own turn in Home

2019.author: huben0423-hw
2019.body:
## 问题

从某个 Bee 直接进入它的会话页时，助手回复的 Markdown 不渲染，`##`、`**`、`|---|` 表格语法原样显示（#2018）。

根因：`HiveBeeConversation.ets` 的 `History()` 用 `Text(row.text)` 渲染所有行，而 Home 主对话的助手回复走 `CloudMarkdownView`，所以同样的内容在 Home 正常、在 Bee 直达页是纯文本。

## 改动

只改 1 个文件、+8/-1：

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/HiveBeeConversation.ets`
  - 新增 `import { CloudMarkdownView } from '../CloudHome/components/CloudMarkdownView';`
  - `History()` 内按角色分流：`row.role === 'user'` 仍用 `Text`；其余（Bee / Beebou 派单）改用
    ```ts
    CloudMarkdownView({ text: row.text, streaming: false, foldLongReply: false })
    ```

说明：
- `CloudMarkdownView` 本身一行未改，只是新增一个调用方；其 `onOpenLink` 默认空实现、mermaid 系列回调可选，因此只传上述三个参数是安全的。
- `foldLongReply: false` 是刻意选择：这是专门的 Bee 会话页，长报告应完整展开，而不是折叠成概览卡。
- 用户消息气泡、`maxWidth: 86%` 布局约束、气泡底色、以及同文件第 476 行“停止任务”按钮下的小字标签（`Text(row.text)`，10px/maxWidth 100）均未改动。

## 影响面

- 仅「从 Bee 直接进入的会话页」；Home 主对话、CloudHome、Beebou 活动面板不受影响。
- 预期副作用：长报告渲染开销上升（单页静态列表）、表格在 86% 宽度内可能横向溢出、链接会显示为可点样式但当前无跳转处理（改造前是纯文本不可点）。

## 验证

- ArkTS 编译通过：`build_hap.py --source-dir <fix-2018> --config <20026>` → `BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 1m43s`，包内端点仍为 `wss://onlineswarm.openjiuwen.com:20026/digitalmate/ws`。
- 签名通过：sha256 `c721e680a9e74af0b2d2a9adf3ebef94747fd6ad653add1af9d3a4f9bb1868a9`，签名 / 证书链 / 20026 四端点校验 PASS。

**未验证（阻塞）**：真机安装与视觉验收未完成——执行 `hdc install` 时报 `[Fail][E001005] Device not found or connected`，`hdc list targets` 为空，重启 hdc 后仍未恢复，判定为设备未连接（USB 断开或调试授权失效），不是包的问题。因此以下项目仍需在设备上确认：标题/加粗/表格/分隔线的渲染效果、表格横向溢出、长报告滚动与渲染耗时、链接呈现。

## 关联

Closes #2018
Related: #1665（post-HIVE 非阻塞事项汇总）

2019.title: fix(entry): render Bee conversation replies as Markdown (#2018)
